PactSignal · Product vision

From conversations
to accountable decisions.

See what was agreed, what changed, and which commitments still need evidence or a human decision.

The gap we address

A conversation keeps moving after a status is set. A customer adds work, changes a date, or says a payment is on its way. A manager needs to know whether the current status still reflects the agreement—and why.

PactSignal brings the relevant messages and supporting evidence into one decision queue, so the person responsible can check the context and choose the next step.

Where PactSignal fits

We see PactSignal as a layer for reviewing commitments alongside email, messaging channels, CRM and accounting systems. Email holds the conversation; CRM organizes relationships and deals; accounting records financial events. Our direction is to connect those views and highlight inconsistencies that need attention.

CRM products already manage tasks, deadlines and communication. PactSignal’s proposed distinction is evidence-linked review of whether a recorded status still matches later commitments and confirmations. That value needs to be demonstrated in real use.

A concrete decision, with its evidence

In the photography example, ten images have been delivered. The client then requests twenty more, while explicitly leaving that extra work unapproved. PactSignal surfaces the scope issue alongside the original order and the source message. The owner can see why a separate quote is needed.

A promise to pay, a client’s claim of payment and a matched settlement record remain different states. An ambiguous receipt stays available for review instead of silently closing the wrong order.

WORKING SHOWCASE TODAY

Two businesses. One review approach.

The interactive showcase contains fictional photography and repair cases processed by the local Python analyzer. Visitors can filter cases, switch scenarios and inspect correspondence, classifications and evidence. Financial-state handling is combined with bounded rules for explicit operational phrases.

The hosted demo uses precomputed results; it does not connect visitors’ mailboxes or run fresh analysis on their data. The project includes a local analysis implementation. Synthetic examples and automated checks demonstrate behavior, but do not establish independent accuracy or real customer validation.

DEVELOPMENT DIRECTION

One agreement, across conversations.

  1. Connected email: make authorized mailbox ingestion and continuing review simple enough for everyday use.
  2. Messaging and handover: bring authorized conversations from channels such as Telegram and WhatsApp into a shared case history. Preserve the source, distinguish a proposed change from an accepted one, and let a replacement manager see unresolved decisions. Channel connections and identity matching remain development work.
  3. CRM and accounting connections: read deal, order, invoice and fulfilment records and compare them with the conversation.
  4. Payment evidence: connect supported payment sources and handle partial, combined and ambiguous settlements with clear provenance.
  5. Assisted action: prepare a reply, task or proposed status change for approval, with controls appropriate to its consequences.

These integrations and workflows are a roadmap, not capabilities demonstrated by this hosted version. Small service teams are a practical starting audience; the same review problem can also arise in companies with established business systems.

Our vision

A manager’s assistant that notices when commitments and the recorded state of work begin to diverge—and makes the reason easy to inspect.

От договорённостей в переписке к ясности в делах

PactSignal помогает увидеть, что согласовано, что изменилось и где требуется решение человека. От общей картины можно перейти к конкретному письму и проверить основание вывода.

Мы видим его рядом с почтой, мессенджерами, CRM и учётной системой: как слой проверки соответствия договорённостей и текущего состояния дела. CRM уже умеют вести задачи и сделки; ценность PactSignal мы связываем с обнаружением расхождений и понятными свидетельствами для их разбора.

Сейчас демонстрация показывает вымышленные кейсы фотостудии и ремонтной мастерской, обработанные локальным анализатором: изменение условий, дополнительную работу, ожидание согласования и разные виды подтверждения оплаты. Подключения к CRM, учётным и платёжным системам относятся к развитию продукта.

Договорённость может начаться в email, измениться в Telegram или WhatsApp и перейти к другому менеджеру. В направлении развития — единая история дела с исходными сообщениями, согласованными условиями, неподтверждёнными изменениями и передачей ответственности. Интерактивный вымышленный сценарий передачи дела показывает эту логику; действующих подключений к мессенджерам пока нет.

Для руководителя — меньше восстановления контекста и яснее приоритеты. Для исполнителя — понятнее следующий шаг. Наше видение: помощник, который замечает, когда договорённости и фактическое положение дел начинают расходиться.
